title: Typed GateError schema with structured fields
body: Replace free-text gate decisions with a typed error shape: `error_code, field_path, remediation, details, source_of_truth`. Aligns with the canonical ReviewResult schema already at `compose/contracts/review-result.json` — extends the same pattern to all gate failures so the cockpit can render structured failures and audit traces become grep-able. ContextGraph paper makes every fail-closed gate a typed `RealityError` with these fields. **Foundation for IDEA-1, IDEA-3:** they all emit/consume this shape.
